_comment: A 46-man Infantry block on 10 files (a short rear rank of 6) stands alone in drill mode at (520, 440) facing south. At tick 24 it about-faces in place (V), which leaves its grid folded a half-turn under the men. At tick 180 it is narrowed to 9 files ([) and ordered north (right-click at (520, 240)) on the same tick, so the order's hold-ground re-square meets a file count no slot query has laid out yet and deals the files from where the men stand. The tick-180 sample is the deal before anyone has walked. The block goes from 5 ranks to 6 and from 10 files to 9 (file and rank pitch both 18 wu), so the new grid sits half a file pitch to the side of the old one and half a rank pitch deeper at each end: every man's slot lies half a file pitch (9 wu) sideways of him, and in depth 23 men step up half a rank pitch, 14 step up a rank and a half, and 9 step back half a rank. The farthest is therefore sent hypot(9, 27) = 28.5 wu. The slot_distance_max tol of 36 wu (two rank pitches) is that 28.5 wu with 7.5 wu to spare, and well short of a walk through the block: on main the re-square reversed each file's ranks on top of the deal, sending men up to four and a half rank pitches along their own file, the farthest 81.5 wu.
